categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the macOS label and addresses a platform-specific runtime failure where macOS select() rejects large timeouts with EINVAL.
categories.rationale: Fixes a regression causing `bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0` to fail immediately on macOS and BSD systems with 'Could not connect to the server'. While it only affects a specific CLI option rather than breaking the platform entirely, supported-platform runtime breakages are high-priority maintenance items.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies Sock::WaitMany in src/util/sock.cpp and carries the Utils/log/libs label.
categories.rationale: Prevents utility socket calls from failing or overflowing on extremely large timeout inputs by capping Sock::WaitMany duration to INT_MAX milliseconds. This directly resolves a regression introduced in #34342 that broke zero-timeout RPC calls on macOS.
